sections.title: 💻 Software Development
sections.summary: The sources mention several frameworks and libraries, including Spark, Cordova, Ember, Vue, Angular JS, Hadoop, and Node.js. Spark is an open-source micro framework for creating web applications in Kotlin and Java, with its latest version launched in 2014. Ember uses the MVVM paradigm for building modern user interfaces and has an ever-growing community. Vue is a lightweight JavaScript framework perfect for building single-page apps. Angular JS, brought by Google in 2012, is used for building dynamic web pages. Hadoop is an open-source framework for storing and distributing large data sets. Node.js is a JavaScript runtime environment ideal for developing cross-platform apps. The sources do not provide information on new frameworks and libraries released specifically for 2026.

sections.summary: Kubernetes supports DevOps practices through automated deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications, enabling continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) with tools like Helm and CI/CD pipelines. It uses declarative infrastructure as code (IaC) to define resource states, integrates with GitOps for automated deployments, and supports rolling updates for safer deployments. Kubernetes also emphasizes developer and operator empowerment, balancing developers' freedom with operators' management and security policies. The New Stack monitors Kubernetes advancements in accommodating AI/ML workloads and cloud-native security improvements.
